description: Questionnaire generator mapping. Source: PDT v1.2 §10.1. One question validates exactly one discovery; options must come from quoted text.

mapping.options_rule: Options = intent list + open-ended 'Other' catch-all; new and existing intents listed side by side
mapping.question_template: In the last month, what did you mainly use your kitchen scale for?
mapping.validates: Whether this intent really exists in the target population and how common it is

mapping.options_rule: Two options forced choice, or ranking of intents
mapping.question_template: Which matters more to you: seeing nutrition on the scale, or more accurate weighing?
mapping.validates: When several intents hold at once, which one users would pay for first

mapping.question_template: Have you ever had the app fail to sync while logging? How bothersome was it (0-4)?
mapping.validates: Whether a heavily complained-about problem is an isolated case or a common friction

mapping.options_rule: Trigger options summarised from migration posts, each with its quote evidence
mapping.question_template: Under what circumstances would you replace your current scale?

mapping.options_rule: Every questionnaire keeps 1-2 fixed open questions; answers feed directly into the discovery layer as new raw material
mapping.question_template: What else about weighing frustrates you? (optional)
mapping.validates: Entry point for the next discovery round

rules: Options must come from quoted text; never invent scenarios; each option carries its evidence count and representative quote, clickable back to source.
One question validates exactly one discovery; never bundle several discoveries into one question.
Rank candidate questions by ODI: importance x satisfaction gap; larger gaps asked first.

Discussion volume may be converted into voting options as question candidates, but in-site voting results do not equal target-population distribution; validation still goes through the formal questionnaire.
Multiple-choice 'pick at most N' must be written in the question text; over-selected answers are excluded at analysis (Forms does not enforce the limit).
One demographic question only, optional, at the end; no email collection; anonymous.
Predicted answers must be labelled 'estimate'; generator's expected distribution and sample answers are never mixed with real collected data.
title: Discovery Type to Question Type Mapping
